title: Agreement Acceptance
description: An individual party's acceptance of a specific agreement version and content digest, with authority and consent evidence references.

acceptance_id.description: Unique identifier of this acceptance record.

party_id.description: The agreement party on whose behalf acceptance is recorded.

authority_ref.description: Reference to evidence of authority to accept this agreement on behalf of party_id.

consent_evidence_ref.description: Reference to evidence of the party's acceptance of the exact agreement version and digest.

utcDateTime.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ending in Z.

agreement_version.description: Exact business version of the referenced agreement.

agreement_digest.description: Exact content digest of the referenced agreement.
